Post-upgrade, explicit proxy policies may mismatch when an HTTP CONNECT request or TLS SNI of a HTTPS session partially matches to a policy with deep inspection enabled.
Policy lookup should not get result with policy_action: deny for non-TCP protocols and non-80/443 TCP ports.
For local out DNAT traffic, the best output route may not be found.
GUI does not display the configured parameters for traffic shaping policies when editing a policy with an SD-WAN zone.
Changing the destination in the policy replaces applied services with service, ALL.

When allow-traffic-redirect is enabled (default setting), redirect traffic that ingresses and egresses from the same interface may incorrectly get dropped if the source address of the incoming packet is different from the FortiGate's interface subnet and there is no firewall policy to allow the matched traffic.
observations.workaround: disable allow-traffic-redirect and create a firewall policy to allow traffic to ingress and egress for the same interface. config system global set allow-traffic-redirect disable end

observations.description: After a failover, ARP entries are removed from all slots when an ARP query of single slot does not respond.
IPv6 ECMP is not supported for the FortiGate 6000F and 7000E platforms. IPv6 ECMP is supported for the FortiGate 7000F platform.
UTM traffic is blocked by an FGSP configuration with asymmetric routing.
On the FortiGate 7000E and 7000F platforms, Managed FortiSwitches will not connect to Fortilink interfaces.
observations.workaround: manually set the LACP mode of the Fortilink interface to static: config system interface edit fortilink set lacp-mode static end

observations.description: Virtual clustering is not supported by FortiGate 6000 and 7000 platforms.
SNMP walk failed to get the BGP routing information.
Authenticated users are not synchronized to the secondary FortiGate 6000 or 7000 chassis when the secondary chassis joins a primary chassis to form an FGCP cluster.
The FortiGate 6000 and 7000 platforms do not support IPsec VPN over a loopback interface or an NPU inter-VDOM link interface.

On the FortiGate 7000F platform, fragmented IPv6 ICMP traffic is not load balanced correctly when the dp-icmp-distribution-method option under config load-balance is set to dst-ip. This problem may also occur for other dp-icmp-distribution-method configurations.

The FortiGate 6000s or 7000s in an FGSP cluster may load balance FTP data sessions to different FPCs or FPMs. This can cause delays while the affected FortiGate 6000 or 7000 re-installs the sessions on the correct FPC or FPM.
FortiGate 7000E IPv6 routes may not be synchronized correctly among FIMs and FPMs.

FortiGate 7000F chassis with FIM-7941Fs cannot load balance fragmented IPv6 TCP and UDP traffic. Instead, fragmented IPv6 TCP and UDP traffic received by the FIM-7941F interfaces is sent directly to the primary FPM, bypassing the NP7 load balancers. IPv6 ICMP fragmented traffic load balancing works as expected. Load balancing fragmented IPv6 TCP and UDP traffic works as expected in FortiGate 7000F chassis with FIM-7921Fs.
Graceful upgrade from 7.0.12 to 7.2.6 or 7.2.7, or from 7.0.12 to 7.4.2 or 7.4.3 will fail on the FortiGate 6501F/6500F, FortiGate 7060E with slot6 occupied, and FortiGate 7121F with slot12 occupied.
observations.workaround: Disable uninterruptible-upgrade before performing the firmware upgrade:

observations.description: FIM installed NPU session causes the SSE to get stuck.
On the Dashboard > FortiView Websites page, the Category filter does not work in the Japanese GUI.

Read-only administrator may encounter a Maximum number of monitored interfaces reached error when viewing an interface bandwidth widget for an interface that does not have the monitor bandwidth feature enabled.
observations.workaround: super_admin users can enable the monitor bandwidth feature on the interface first, then the widget can work for read-only administrators.

observations.description: When the FortiGate is in conserve mode, node process (GUI management) may not release memory properly causing entry-level devices to stay in conserve mode.
When administrator GUI access (HTTPS) is enabled on SD-WAN member interfaces, the GUI may not be accessible on the SD-WAN interface due to incorrect routing of the response packet.
observations.workaround: access the GUI using another internal interface that is not part of an SD-WAN link.

observations.description: When editing an SD-WAN rule with more than one destination, some destinations are automatically removed.
System > HA: No Upgrade button is visible on secondary GUI page when HA in "local-only" or "secondary-only" MVC upgrade mode.
observations.workaround: Upgrade the secondary using the command line.

observations.description: Connections per second (CPS) performance of SIP sessions accepted by hyperscale firewall policies with EIM and EIF disabled that include overload with port block allocation (PBA) GCN IP pools is lower than expected.
observations.workaround: enter the following command for each NP7 processor to resolve the performance issue. # diagnose npu np7 setreg <npu_#> nss.nss_thrd_ctrl.thrd_ctrl 0xF Where <npu_#> is the NP7 processor number. NP7 processors are numbered 0, 1, 2, and so on. The configuration changes from entering these diagnose commands are reset if the FortiGate restarts. After a system restart, re-enter the diagnose commands.

observations.description: ICMP reply packets are dropped by FortiOS with a NAT64 hyperscale policy.
Fatal errors occur when the IPS engine sends requests with zero-length data segments to IPSA.
Unexpected condition in IPsec engine on SoC4 platforms leads to intermittent IPsec VPN operation.
FortiAnalyzer report is not available to view for the secondary unit in the HA cluster on the Log & Report > Reports page.
observations.workaround: view the report directly in FortiAnalyzer.

observations.description: FortiGate syslog format in reliable transport mode is not compliant with RFC 6587.
An error case occurs in WAD while redirecting the web filter HTTPS sessions.
A rare error condition occurred in WAD caused by compounded SMB2 requests.
An error case occurs in WAD when it gets the external authenticated users from other daemons.
The diagnose ip rtcache list command is no longer supported in the FortiOS 4.19 kernel.
DNS over TCP does not work when interface-select-method is set to sdwan in the DNS setting, and the corresponding SD-WAN rule is restricted to the TCP protocol only.
observations.workaround: change the DNS method to auto instead of sdwan. This will stop prioritizing DNS traffic based on the SD-WAN rule.

observations.description: When there are over 30 downstream FortiGates in the Security Fabric, the root FortiGate's GUI may experience slowness when loading the Fabric Management page and prevents the user from upgrading firmware in the GUI.
observations.workaround: perform the firmware upgrade in the CLI. To perform the firmware upgrade using the GUI, temporarily disable the Security Fabric on the root FortiGate.

observations.description: Physical and logical topology is slow to load when there are a lot of managed FortiAP devices (over 50). This issue does not impact FortiAP management and operation.
After deauthorizing a downstream FortiGate from the System > Firmware & Registration page, the page may appear to be stuck to loading.
observations.workaround: perform a full page refresh to allow the page to load again.

observations.description: FortiGate as SSL VPN client does not work on NP6 and NP6XLite devices.
Multiple instances of *** code requested backtrace *** for SSL VPN daemon observed during a graceful upgrade (on FG-6000F).
config sync error on managed FSW after upgrade when "Name" field and port exported are configured on the same FSW.
When configuring an 802.3ad aggregate interface with a 1 Gbps speed, the port's LED is off and traffic cannot pass through. Affected platforms: 110xE, 220xE, 330xE, 340xE, and 360xE.
NP7 did not offload jumbo packet, but get NPU INFO: offload=9/9 in the console output.
When the URL filter requests the FortiGuard (FGD) rating server address using DNS, it will try to get both A (IPv4) and AAAA (IPv6) records.
High CPU usage might be observed on entry-level FortiGates if the cache size reaches 10% of the system memory.
DHCP server on LAN interface is lost after rebooting or restoring the configuration file.
Unexpected behavior occurred in the kernel when creating EMAC VLAN interfaces based on an aggregate interface with the new kernel 4.1.9.
After deauthorizing a downstream FortiGate from the System > Firmware & Registration page, the page may appear to be stuck to loading.
observations.workaround: perform a full page refresh to allow the page to load again.

observations.description: A super_admin administrator is unable to log in after restoring the VDOM configuration on the admin VDOM and rebooting the FortiGate.
A kernel panic may result when setting qos-type to shaping in some instances.
observations.workaround: Either disable NP offload or change the NP7 default-qos-type setting from shaping to policing. Restart the device for the configuration to take effect. config system npu set default-qos-type policing end

observations.description: The kernel 4.19 cannot concurrently reassemble IPv4 fragments for a source IP with more than 64 destination IP addresses.
On the NP7 platform, setting the interface configuration using set inbandwidth <x> or set outbandwidth <x> commands stops traffic flow.
When upgrading multiple firmware versions in the GUI, the Follow upgrade path option does not respect the recommended upgrade path.
When a search is performed on a user (User & Authentication > User Definition page), the search results highlight all the groups the user belongs to.
NTLM authentication does not work with Chrome.
Administrator single sign-on login with SAML does not work after upgrading the firmware 7.4.1 due to the SAML entity-id field being incorrectly reset to being empty.
observations.workaround: manually configure the entity-id field in the CLI to match with the previously working configuration. config system saml set entity-id <string> end

observations.description: VLAN traffic fails to pass through E810-XXV NIC with SFP28 transceiver and 25G speed after enabling DPDK.

When there are extra large number of managed FortiAP devices (over 500) and large number of WiFi clients (over 5000), the Managed FortiAPs page and FortiAP Status widget can take a long time to load. This issue does not impact FortiAP operation.
On the WiFi & Switch Controller > Managed FortiAPs page of a non-management VDOM, the Register button is unavailable in the Device Registration pane.
The eap_proxy daemon may keep reloading randomly due to failing to bind a port. This will cause an IKE and WiFi authentication failure.
Mapped drives become inaccessible after laptop reboots when using FortiGate ZTNA access proxy with FQDN destinations.
